title: Keck Planet Finder preliminary design
what_was_studied: Optical architecture, fibre feed, environmental control, calibration and predicted error budget
numerical_result: Design requirement of 0.50 m/s per observation and goal of 0.30 m/s; these were not achieved-performance measurements
remaining_question: The as-built system and later detector or calibration eras must be evaluated separately

title: Staring at the Sun with the Keck Planet Finder
what_was_studied: Autonomous Sun-as-a-star feed, quality control and comparison with contemporaneous NEID solar velocities
numerical_result: Five-second spectra reached signal-to-noise about 1200; KPF and NEID agreed at 0.30 to 0.40 m/s over several-hour intervals
remaining_question: Early detector and wavelength-calibration problems prevent treating the short comparison as long-term stellar accuracy

title: System design of the Keck Planet Finder
what_was_studied: As-built science spectrometers, Ca II H and K channel, exposure meter, solar feed and calibration system
numerical_result: Installed in late 2022 and commissioned in early 2023; main optical coverage is 445 to 870 nm at resolving power about 98000
remaining_question: Initial on-sky performance predates later service missions and the 2026 vacuum-system failure

title: KPF Data Reduction Pipeline release history
what_was_studied: Versioned extraction, wavelength, master-calibration, quality-control and instrument-era changes
numerical_result: Release 2.12.1 documents new regression tests and an order-trace indexing fix after earlier releases added KPF era and service-mission definitions
remaining_question: A release log records software changes but does not quantify their effect on held-out stellar RV time series

title: KPF subsystem status
what_was_studied: Current availability following the April 2026 vacuum-pump event
numerical_result: Keck states that KPF is offline until further notice after a turbo-pump failure
remaining_question: A return date and post-repair performance characterization were not available on the checked page
